digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport layer
propositions: When JIRA_PAT environment variable is absent or empty, the DC client construction falls back to anonymous access instead of raising a named error
The documented security guarantee that a missing JIRA_PAT fails with an error naming the variable is not enforced in the client initialization path

An empty or whitespace-only PAT is passed to the Jira client as a bearer token, allowing anonymous requests that produce misleading error messages about missing projects rather than missing credentials
Settings resolution must remain total (not raise on missing JIRA_PAT) to preserve Python 3.11+ Protocol conformance checks that probe properties via hasattr
Client construction must validate the PAT before any network call or client instantiation and must reject empty, whitespace-only, or missing credentials with an error message naming JIRA_PAT
